title: Make five sample products before asking for orders

content_json.title: Make five sample products before asking for orders
content_json.what_it_means: People should see real examples before they trust a new business.
what_to_do: Create five sample products in different styles.
Record close-up videos while making them.
Use the samples in your first Instagram posts and WhatsApp status.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can make five sample {{product}} for birthdays, farewell gifts, best friends, couples, and college events in {{location}}.
content_json.why_this_helps: People understand what you sell faster when they see real products instead of plain posters.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if people reply asking for price, preview, or delivery after seeing the samples.

title: Start with three actions, not a huge plan

content_json.title: Start with three actions, not a huge plan
content_json.what_it_means: A new business needs a few clear first moves, not too many tasks.
what_to_do: Prepare sample products.
Write the WhatsApp order steps.
Post a simple launch teaser.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can say: We are opening soon in {{location}}. Send your idea on WhatsApp, see a preview, and confirm before we make it.
content_json.why_this_helps: Simple first actions help you move today instead of waiting for a perfect launch.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if at least five people ask what you are launching or how to order.

content_json.title: Use a seven-day launch countdown
content_json.what_it_means: People remember a launch better when they see it many times in different ways.
what_to_do: Post one simple launch update every day for seven days.
Show samples, price range, order steps, delivery area, and launch offer.
Repeat the same update on WhatsApp status.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can run a seven-day countdown for {{audience}} in {{location}} with one product video each day.
content_json.why_this_helps: A countdown gives people time to notice, ask questions, and share it with friends.
content_json.how_to_check: Check story views, replies, saves, and WhatsApp messages during the seven days.

content_json.title: Collect interested people before opening
content_json.what_it_means: You do not need full orders before launch. You need a list of people who want to see the first products.
what_to_do: Ask people to message the word preview.
Save their names in a simple list.
Send them first access when samples are ready.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can post: Message preview if you want to see the first custom gift samples before launch.
content_json.why_this_helps: A small list gives you warm people to contact on launch day.
content_json.how_to_check: Check how many people message preview and what product they ask about.

title: Set up Google Business before launch day

content_json.title: Set up Google Business before launch day
content_json.what_it_means: Local buyers trust a business more when they can find it on Google.
what_to_do: Add business name, category, location, hours, and contact method.
Upload sample product photos.
Add a post saying launch orders are opening soon.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can add photos of sample {{product}} and mention delivery or pickup in {{deliveryArea}}.
content_json.why_this_helps: People in {{location}} can check if the business looks real before messaging.
content_json.how_to_check: Check profile views, direction clicks, calls, and WhatsApp clicks.

content_json.title: Use a simple launch offer
content_json.what_it_means: A launch offer should be easy to understand and easy to explain.
what_to_do: Give the first few buyers a small gift-packing add-on.
Avoid confusing discounts.
Make the offer clear in one line.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can say: First 20 launch orders get free gift packing in {{location}}.
content_json.why_this_helps: A clear offer gives people a reason to order early without making the brand look cheap.
content_json.how_to_check: Check how many people mention the launch offer while messaging.

title: Send a design preview before making the product

content_json.title: Send a design preview before making the product
content_json.what_it_means: Customers should see the look before you start making the order.
what_to_do: Ask for name, photo, colour, size, and spelling.
Send a simple preview image or mockup.
Start making only after the customer confirms.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can reply: I will send a preview first. Please check name, photo, colour, size, and spelling before I make it.
content_json.why_this_helps: This prevents mistakes and makes customers feel safe before paying.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if fewer people ask what happens if the design is wrong.

title: Use a safe six-step custom order process

content_json.title: Use a safe six-step custom order process
content_json.what_it_means: Custom orders need a clear process because small mistakes can create big problems.
what_to_do: Customer sends name, photo, design idea, and delivery date.
Shop sends preview.
Customer confirms details.
Customer pays advance.
Product is made.
Final photo is sent before delivery.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can pin this process in Instagram highlights and send it as the first WhatsApp reply.
content_json.why_this_helps: Customers trust the order more when every step is clear.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if customers send complete details faster after reading the process.

title: Explain advance payment in a calm way

content_json.title: Explain advance payment in a calm way
content_json.what_it_means: Customers should understand why advance payment is needed for custom work.
what_to_do: Ask for advance only after preview and timing are confirmed.
Explain that custom material and making time are reserved.
Send a simple payment confirmation message.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can say: Once you confirm the preview, we take advance so we can reserve material and start your custom order.
content_json.why_this_helps: Clear payment rules reduce doubt and awkward price conversations.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if fewer customers stop replying when advance payment is mentioned.

title: Send a final photo before delivery

content_json.title: Send a final photo before delivery
content_json.what_it_means: Customers feel safer when they see the finished product before it reaches them.
what_to_do: Take one clear final photo.
Send it before delivery or pickup.
Ask the customer to confirm the details once more.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can send: Your order is ready. Please check the final photo before delivery in {{deliveryArea}}.
content_json.why_this_helps: It reduces delivery-time worry and shows that the shop checks details.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if customers reply faster and share happier feedback after delivery.

title: Show the material before people ask

content_json.title: Show the material before people ask
content_json.what_it_means: People want to know if the product will look and feel good in real life.
what_to_do: Record close-up videos of the material.
Show thickness, finish, size, and packaging.
Mention care instructions if needed.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can post a Reel showing the material of a custom gift before the design is added.
content_json.why_this_helps: Material clarity reduces quality doubt and makes price easier to accept.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if people ask fewer basic quality questions in messages.

title: Use a first reply that collects the right details

content_json.title: Use a first reply that collects the right details
content_json.what_it_means: The first reply should make ordering easy without a long conversation.
what_to_do: Ask for product type, name/photo/design, date needed, and delivery area.
Keep the reply friendly and short.
Save it as a WhatsApp quick reply.
content_json.example: Hi, thanks for messaging {{businessName}}. Please send the product idea, name/photo/design, date needed, and area in {{location}}. I will reply with price and preview steps.
content_json.why_this_helps: You get useful details early, and customers feel guided.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if more customers send complete order details in the first message.

content_json.title: Give price without sounding unsure
content_json.what_it_means: Customers should know what affects the price.
what_to_do: Share a starting price or price range.
Mention what can change the price.
Confirm final price after preview details.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can say: Prices start from {{priceRange}}. Final price depends on product size, design detail, and delivery area.
content_json.why_this_helps: Price clarity brings serious buyers and reduces back-and-forth.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if more people continue the chat after receiving price.

title: Ask for preview confirmation in one clean message

content_json.title: Ask for preview confirmation in one clean message
content_json.what_it_means: The customer must confirm small details before the order starts.
what_to_do: Send the preview.
Ask them to check spelling, photo, colour, size, and date.
Start only after they reply confirmed.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can send: Please check the preview carefully. Confirm name spelling, photo, colour, size, and delivery date in {{location}}. I will start making it after you reply confirmed.
content_json.why_this_helps: It protects both the customer and the shop from avoidable mistakes.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if confirmed previews reduce correction requests later.

title: Write an Instagram bio that explains ordering

content_json.title: Write an Instagram bio that explains ordering

content_json.how_to_check: Check if profile visitors start messaging instead of only viewing posts.

content_json.title: Answer what happens if the design is wrong
content_json.what_it_means: Custom product buyers need to know how mistakes are handled.

content_json.why_this_helps: A clear mistake policy makes customers less afraid to order.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if people ask fewer fear-based questions before paying.
